description: The POREDRAIN dataset records 15 laboratory tests of porous asphalt hydraulic performance and clogging at the University of A Coruna. A 36-square-metre street model supplies runoff and effluent observations. The metadata is published or maintained by Goya, Angélica; Naves, Juan; Anta, Jose and coauthors (provider deposit/publication). Coverage is at site scale.
